description: List the modal dialogs After Effects is showing, or dismiss one by its cancel action (what Escape does: a warning is acknowledged, a 'save changes?' question is cancelled — never answered for the user). Use after a DIALOG_OPEN / TIMEOUT error, or before a step known to pop a dialog. Windows + macOS; on macOS reading the text and dismissing need Accessibility permission for the app that runs this server.

action.description: list — report open dialogs; dismiss — close the one named by `id`.

id.description: Dialog id from a previous list / DIALOG_OPEN error (required for dismiss).

name: ae_dialogs
title: After Effects dialogs
